_comment: Data-driven cases for tests/subscription-update-shipping-address.spec.js. Each key (except _comment) becomes its own Playwright test() — run one with -g "<Country>". Parallels data/shipping-address-cases.json (the /account-details shipping form uses the SAME <address-form> component) but adds firstName/lastName (the subscription Recipient Info modal exposes them) and uses UNIQUE tokens per field so the backend shippingAddress round-trip can assert each value via a substring match without false positives. Select values are "<code>|<name>" exactly as the live <select> exposes them. expectOptionPresent/expectOptionAbsent assert the Country->State/Province dropdown swap. zip uses that country's postal format. Restore is automatic (the test snapshots the sub's real recipient first, then writes it back — country flipped back to US last).
